behaviorProbePhases.syntheticIdentityNote: This project has exactly one real auth.users row (the founder). Per explicit founder direction (2026-07-31: "Insert a synthetic second auth.users row, rollback-contained"), this phase inserted synthetic auth.users rows inside the same rollback-contained transaction to supply the second and third identities public.crew_members/crew_memberships/crew_check_in_shares/bridge_signals relationships require. Live pg_catalog inspection confirmed the only two AFTER INSERT triggers on auth.users (initialize_account_verification(), initialize_app_profile()) are pure public-schema inserts with no pg_net/Edge Function calls, so the synthetic inserts carried no effect that would survive ROLLBACK. Post-run verification confirmed auth.users count returned to 1 and zero tagged rows remained in any touched table.
